newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY ELECTRICITY UNIONS, BOSSES REACH PAY DEAL.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY ELECTRICITY UNIONS, BOSSES REACH PAY DEAL.

text.p: Unions and employers in Hungary's electricity sector agreed on a wage increase on Friday of an average 18 percent for 1997.
A formal agreement will be signed next week, the Hungairan economic news agency MTI-Econews reported.

The Electricity Industry Workers' Trade Union Association (VIDSZSZ) staged protests for higher wages in Germany and Belgium last Decembery against Western investors in Hungary's power sector who they said had reneged on promises to keep workers' salaries in line with inflation.
The union said employees would receive only a 19.5 percent back payment for 1996, while they were expecting 25 percent. They had threatened strike action in pursuit of their claim.
Hungary's government targets average inflation of 17 percent for 1997.
